simple.summary: עַצְמוֹן (ʻAtsmôwn) means Atsmon , a place near Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 4.

definitions.full: H6111. Atsmon עַצְמֹוֺן proper name, of a location Ασε ( λ ) μωνα on extreme southern border of Canaan, Num 34:5 , with ה locative עַצְמֹ֫נָה 34:4 , עַצְמ֫וֺנָה Josh 15:4 .
